summary: Enterprise B2C/B2B commerce platform from Salesforce with storefront and headless commerce APIs.
access_note: Requires a licensed B2C Commerce instance and Account Manager API client; sandbox is provisioned for customers. Not verified from docs (pages returned 403).
blocker_note: Enterprise licensed product; API clients exist only inside a customer or partner instance. Shopper MCP is a pilot requiring account executive contact.

evidence.quote: The B2C MCP server connects your AI assistant to Salesforce B2C Commerce tools, documentation, and workflow skills.

notes: developer.salesforce.com pages returned HTTP 403 to every fetch, so auth (Account Manager client_credentials for SCAPI Admin; SLAS OAuth 2.1 for Shopper), access and REST claims come from search result summaries only and have no verified quotes. MCP server is developer tooling (npm @salesforce/b2c-dx-mcp), developer preview.
